prompt_text: Add 1uL 1mM clofibrate in DMSO to wells A2:H2 with an 8-channel pipette
expectation_source: spec per-prompt criteria P5: wells EXACTLY A2:H2 (eight wells — the compiler's own expansion A2,B2,...,H2 via wellRange.ts, where the LETTER is the row and the NUMBER the column, so A2:H2 = rows A..H at column 2; the `wells` array above is that compiler expansion, never a re-derived axis mapping) AND the 8-channel constraint honored (B8): the constraint is only meaningful as an 8-channel operation — ONE material-bearing event over exactly this 8-well set (honest channel count, if the event carries one, must agree with 8); a 96-well single-channel interpretation or a spread of smaller ops (no single op over the full 8-well set) FAILS. channel_semantics encodes that shape; the driver asserts it structurally over the `wells` set (advc cycle-1 D1).
